Nationwide Coverage

Nationwide Medical Billing Services

ProtoMed provides professional medical billing and revenue cycle management (RCM) services to healthcare practices in all 50 states. No matter where your practice is located, our certified billing experts know your state's Medicaid rules, payer requirements, and compliance regulations inside out.

We handle everything from medical coding and claim submission to denial management and accounts receivable recovery so you can focus on delivering great patient care and leave the billing to us.
